race.comment: An 80K MCC Series Heat will start the quaddie over 1600m. NAVY KING (1) was doing his best work late over this trip in a tougher field second up at Sandown-Hillside a month ago, and will have a 2kg claim to help offset his weight rise for this easier assignment. A wide draw will make it tough, but with the right tow into it around the final bend, he can unleash a quick finish. On top. GEFFINA (6) is normally running on in her races, and she was just over 2 lengths from the winner at Murray Bridge 2 weeks ago. Include in all top 4 combos. BREATHLESS SPIRIT (7) made good progress last season, and has done well over his spell, winning the latest of his 2 tune-up jump-outs. If he does not need the run, then he can figure in the top 3. SHAMEX (14) has been freshened since a last start BM62 win over 2000m. Include.
